batches.title: Security priority completion
batches.scope: Finish the eight independently scoped security machinery repairs and native source-only runner before other port implementation. Preserve upstream and independent challenge; SA01 permission bits are only a prerequisite.

batches.title: Capability catalog and native-only installation
batches.scope: Introduce one reviewed catalog used by installer, doctor/preflight and native entry resolution; expand installation only as entries meet declared availability.

batches.title: Shared graph host and native role transport
batches.scope: Extract/reuse proven native seams without changing graph stage logic; support agent and nested workflow operations, semantic schemas, bounded execution and per-agent checkpoints.

batches.title: Shared references and host helpers
batches.scope: Relocatable references/helpers, same contracts and host enforcement; no fabricated graph for reference text.

batches.title: Blueprint interview/design/backlog
batches.scope: Native graph entry through binding interview, independent design/backlog gates, exact approval and documentation writes.

batches.title: QA and loop
batches.scope: Port shared harness-repair workflow and loop entry before nested dev integration; preserve stuck signatures and bounded fixing.

batches.title: Dev implementation graph
batches.scope: Native planner/advisor/scout/implementer/checker/acceptance/triage plus nested QA; preserve saved plan semantics.

batches.title: Build-app driver
batches.scope: Explicit provider dispatch and native probes/sessions throughout driver, including lifecycle, locks, per-slice gates, final QA/hunt and controlled PR flow.

batches.title: Release graph
batches.scope: Exact-head docs/readiness/approval/merge/deploy state machine through native leaves; offline remote adapters for proof.

batches.title: Existing native offerings parity regression
batches.scope: Retain working native entrypoints and same graph/gates; full matrix of stage failure, capability limits and no Claude fallback.

batches.title: Project bootstrap and provider configuration
batches.scope: Provider-neutral entry instructions and explicit provider outputs; compatibility aliases and generated config fixtures.

batches.title: Engineering guided workflows
batches.scope: Supported native delegation for deep workflows; representative scoped code/data fixtures for guided protocols without demanding a process for plain prose.

batches.title: Git, documentation and read-only service tools
batches.scope: Provider-neutral invocation, destructive action boundaries, exact intended Git changes and service read-only behavior.

batches.title: Marketing and SEO
batches.scope: All offerings includes marketing: same content protocols, truthful claims, correct runtime helper installation and representative outputs.

batches.title: Full-install and cross-offering conformance
batches.scope: Clean Codex-only installation and composed workflows, catalog coverage, no hidden Claude runtime, honest documented unsupported presentation limits.
